title: 第十二章 古墓第十三章 珍馐老仙
content_zh:
韩紫枫继续开始美食大讲堂：“考究一点就做个炉子，几层架子，地瓜放里面烤，百姓甚至还能拿除去卖钱，那种热热乎乎的最适合冬天。另一种吃饭就是，煮粥，削皮、切块，跟白米一起煮粥，味道甜甜的不说，关键是比纯米粥顶饿，甚至没米，白地瓜隔水蒸，也行啊，切块炸至金黄，确定里面软了，然后混上糖色，趁热，拔丝吃。炖肉也能往里丢些。”
“美食的产出，是跟厨师的脑洞画等号的，额，形象力画等号的。甚至糊糖葫芦，也是能操作的。土豆，基本地瓜的吃饭，它都能胜任，还可以配各种菜，炖、少、闷。最简单的就是切丝，热炒，加糖醋。酸酸甜甜，超级开胃。”
“更简单易操作的，就是把土豆切片，隔水蒸熟，然后用捣蒜泥的家伙，把土豆捣成泥，上面加上特制的酱汁，大体你浇什么酱汁，这个土豆泥就是啥味道，绝对百搭。还有，切片，切条，用油炸脆，然后沾酱汁吃，不同做法，味道不一样，吃法不重样。并且全部都是零食啊！管饱，美味，咱值得拥有啊！”
紫枫开始给大皇子介绍，茄子、西红柿、热带水果，萝卜，各种蔬菜。安稳了几天时间，灾区哪边又传来新的急报，说是有好几个百姓，下水捕捉龙虾的时候，被不明生物攻击。并且已经死了好几个百姓啦。
紫枫感觉疑惑，想想啥也不说了，再次拉着北空明去哪边看看，到底发生什么事情。等赶过来，看到被围起来，持续泛滥的河，紫枫突然有一种感觉，并不会是吃人鱼之类的玩意吧？
北空明也具体的跟周围村民问问，大家都表示：“下水后，就感觉被什么咬了的样子，等他们捞出来，就变成骨头啦。”
紫枫顿时说：“这里又狗没？做个钓竿，把狗吊在河面上，给狗的身子，放一个小口子，看看情况。”很快，周围百姓看到一条条鱼，咔吧这牙齿，从水里攒上来，那条狗，也算是分分钟被咔嚓掉。
这下一群百姓是真惊悚啦，紫枫也开始犯愁，食人鱼是这个东西，就算在热武器的现代，那都是很麻烦的东西，现在这个纯冷兵器的时代，这个东西就真的又点坑爹啦。
紫枫一摊手说：“这下麻烦有点大，这些鱼，号称食人鱼。真的属于，见到货物就被咔嚓掉。就现在的工艺水平，真拿这群货没办法啊！这些东西，铁网子都不见得能好用，这下有点麻烦。”
她想想，直接用系统投诉问：“提问，强效安眠药，能叫河里的食人鱼陷入沉睡不？那些东西打捞上岸，应该就能死了把？”
霖华仙尊笑嘻嘻的说：“这个玩意儿，我回收，我给你个网子，你直接叫人两边一兜。提示，附近有古墓，这些食人鱼，是从古墓哪边出来的，那些龙虾也是哦。”
紫枫瞬间沉默了，想一阵说：“额，一个好消息，一堆坏消息，先听那个？”
北空明说：“都说来听听。”
紫枫回答：“我能治理这些鱼，但鱼归我。坏消息是，龙虾、和这些鱼，都是从附近的古墓溜达出来的。不知道古墓中，还有什么，需要专业的盗墓贼，去看看，不排除墓穴里有更奇葩的东西昂。”
一群人能说啥安排呗，叫紫枫都比较意外的是，他们居然看到搬山道人啦，紫枫大概问问，他们还真要找雮尘珠的样子。子沫直接用系统的投诉问：“亲，你那里有雮尘珠贩卖不？他们拿走能有用不，凡人社会的东西哦。”
霖华仙尊扫视一下周围几个目标任务，然后感知一下说：“这个把。”他很快给了紫枫一张作案地图说：“这个需要他们自己去搞定。”
紫枫说：“把这个给整合成书、地图的样子，叫他们自己研究去呗。”很快紫枫手里就出现两张地图，她反手就把地图丢给几个搬山道人随后说：“能帮你们的，都帮你们啦，剩下的要靠你们自己啦，按着书，流程搞定，你们就没事啦。作为费用，你们把这个破地方，给咱整明白，直接掏干净就好。”
搬山道人看看手里的书，然后都惊啦，这也太明确了吧？有这本书，他们敢拍着胸脯说，保证无压力就能把事情办完。于是，他们一个人负责把书带回族里，剩下的三人，负责下墓。
其他的发丘、摸金相对，就没啥额外需求，等一群人进入墓中，没想最先有反应的居然是霖华仙尊：“我去，你真是锦鲤啊！这个墓穴中的东西，老子要了。”
紫枫点点点的说：“啥玩意啊喂？”

霖华仙尊想一下回答：“额，我是仙尊，这里的那个传承，是另外一个仙尊的遗留在下界的传承，赚到啦。”
紫枫超级好奇的问：“教啥的？话说，给留个文字版什么的呗，你拷贝一份也就算了，连锅端不讲究啦。”很快，霖华仙尊表示，这个可以有。
接着，紫枫就变成带路的，这一路上的机关，自然是交给那些专业的家伙处理一下。这里大多数还是能吃的范畴，比如小龙虾、螃蟹、蛤蜊、耗子、蝙蝠、狐狸、黄鼠狼、蛇等等。
好在，这里还是有很多百姓跟着的，这些能充当食物的，紫枫淡定的问：“亲，我把这里的活物回收，你能给我变成肉肉不？直接吃我跑闹疫症。”
霖华仙尊很是无语，不过，这也是必须的，毕竟，因果已经在哪里啦，他出个手，也是没什么问题的。于是，这附近的百姓，就见到金光一闪。紫枫收到信息：“叫人抓就完事啦。”
紫枫跟旁边的北空明说：“那啥，别客气了，叫百姓过来抓，直接问厨师怎么吃就完事啦。”
一群嗷嗷待哺的饥民，那还跟这些客气，紫枫淡定说：“这里耗子也能吃，之前的金光清理过啦。”一群百姓抓抓抓。

Han Zifeng continued to start the food lecture: "If you are more sophisticated, just make a stove with several layers of shelves. Put the sweet potatoes in it to bake. People can even take them and sell them for money. The kind of hot ones are best for winter. Another way to eat is to cook porridge, peel and cut it, and Cooking the porridge with white rice will give it a sweeter taste. The key is that it is much hungrier than pure rice porridge, even without rice. You can also steam the white sweet potatoes in water, cut them into pieces and fry them until they are golden, make sure the inside is soft, then mix it with sugar, and eat it while it is hot. You can also add some shredded meat to it. "
"The output of gourmet food is equal to the chef's imagination, um, image ability. Even the candied haws can be manipulated. It can be used to eat potatoes and basic sweet potatoes. It can also be used with various dishes, stewed, light, and stuffy. The simplest is to shred, stir-fry, and add sweet and sour. It is sour and sweet, super appetizing."
"What is simpler and easier to do is to slice the potatoes, steam them over water, then use a garlic masher to mash the potatoes, and add a special sauce on top. The taste of the mashed potatoes will depend on whatever sauce you put on it. It is absolutely versatile. Also, you can slice it, cut it into strips, fry it until crispy, and then eat it with the sauce. Different ways of doing it will give you different tastes and different ways of eating them. And they are all snacks! They are full and delicious, and we deserve it!"
Zifeng began to introduce eggplants, tomatoes, tropical fruits, radishes, and various vegetables to the eldest prince. After a few days of stability, a new emergency report came from the disaster area, saying that several people were attacked by unknown creatures when they went into the water to catch lobsters. And several people have died.
Zifeng felt confused, thought about it and said nothing, and once again took Beikong Ming to where to see what was going on. When he came over and saw the river that was surrounded and continuously flooding, Zifeng suddenly had a feeling, it couldn't be something like a mermaid, right?
Beikong Ming also asked the surrounding villagers specifically, and everyone said: "After entering the water, it felt like something had been bitten. When they took it out, it turned into bones."
Zifeng immediately said: "Are there any dogs here? Make a fishing rod, hang the dog on the river, make a small opening in the dog's body, and see what happens." Soon, the people around saw fish one after another, clicking their teeth and pulling them up from the water. The dog was also clicked away in minutes.
Now a group of common people were really frightened, and Zifeng also began to worry. Piranha is this thing. Even in the modern era of hot weapons, it is a very troublesome thing. Now in this era of pure cold weapons, this thing is really a bit of a scam.
Zifeng spread his hands and said: "This is a bit of a big trouble. These fish are called piranhas. They really belong to them. They will be clicked away when they see the goods. With the current level of craftsmanship, there is really nothing we can do with these goods! These things, even the iron mesh may not be easy to use, this is a bit of a trouble."
She thought about it and complained directly through the system: "Ask a question, can powerful sleeping pills make the piranhas in the river fall into a deep sleep? If those things are salvaged ashore, they should be dead?"
Immortal Linhua said with a smile: "I will recycle this thing. I will give you a net. You can just ask someone to take a bag on both sides. Reminder, there is an ancient tomb nearby. Which side of the ancient tomb did these piranhas come from? So did those lobsters."
Zifeng was silent for a moment, and thought for a while before saying: "Well, a piece of good news and a bunch of bad news, which one do you want to hear first?"
Beikong Ming said, "Come and listen."
Zifeng replied: "I can manage these fish, but the fish belongs to me. The bad news is that the lobsters and these fish all wandered out from the nearby ancient tombs. I don't know what else is in the ancient tombs. I need professional tomb robbers to take a look. I can't rule out that there are even weirder things in the tombs."
What arrangements could a group of people make? Zifeng was surprised that they actually saw Taoist Banshan. Zifeng probably asked, as if they were really looking for Muchen Bead. Zimo directly uses the systemThe complaint asked: "Dear, do you have Muchen Beads for sale over there? Are they taking away useful things from mortal society?"
Immortal Linhua glanced at several target tasks around him, then sensed it and said, "This is it." He quickly gave Zifeng a crime map and said, "They need to handle this by themselves."
Zifeng said: "Integrate this into a book and a map, and let them study it themselves." Soon two maps appeared in Zifeng's hand. She threw the map to a few Taoist monks and said, "I'll help you with whatever I can. The rest is up to you. Follow the book and complete the process, and you'll be fine. As a fee, you can clean up this broken place for us, and just clean it up."
Taoist Banshan looked at the book in his hand and was shocked. Isn't this too clear? With this book, they dare to pat their chests and say that they can get things done without stress. So, one of them was responsible for bringing the book back to the clan, and the remaining three were responsible for going to the grave.
The other hair mounds and gold-touching ones have no additional needs. When a group of people entered the tomb, the first person to react was Lin Hua Immortal: "Fuck you, you are such a koi carp! I want the things in this tomb."
Zifeng nodded and said, "What is this?"
Immortal Linhua thought for a moment and replied: "Well, I am the Immortal. The inheritance here is the inheritance left in the lower world by another Immortal. I have earned it."
Zifeng was super curious and asked: "What are you teaching? By the way, just leave a text version or something. You can just copy it. You don't even care about the pot." Soon, Immortal Linhua said that this is possible.
Then, Zifeng became the leader, and the agencies along the way were naturally handled by those professional guys. Most of the things here are edible, such as crayfish, crabs, clams, rats, bats, foxes, weasels, snakes, etc.
Fortunately, there are still many people following here. These can be used as food. Zifeng asked calmly: "Dear, I will recycle the living creatures here. Can you turn them into meat for me? Eat them directly and cause the epidemic."
Immortal Linhua was very speechless, but this was necessary. After all, the cause and effect was already there, so there would be no problem if he took action. As a result, the people nearby saw a flash of golden light. Zifeng received the message: "Just ask someone to arrest him and that will be it."
Zifeng said to Beikong Ming next to him: "Well, don't be polite. Just ask the people to come and catch it. Just ask the chef how to eat it and that's it."
A group of hungry people were waiting for food. How could they be polite to these people? Zifeng said calmly: "You can eat rats here too. The golden light from before has been cleaned up." A group of people scratched and scratched.
